name: BoardRepo
description:
BoardRepo is where hardware projects live. Store a board here and it stops being a zip file on a laptop: it becomes something your tools, your team, and your AI can all read.

Connect BoardRepo to an assistant and it reads the designs themselves instead of guessing from memory. The schematic and the nets that connect it. The bill of materials. The files in the project. And the public library of real-world boards other people have published. Ask how a part was wired on a board that shipped, what a design is made of, or which published projects use the component in front of you, and the answer comes from a design rather than a recollection.

KiCad and Altium today, and the list of formats is growing.

Access is read-only and OAuth-gated. An assistant can read the public library and every board in your account, including private ones, and it can change nothing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BoardRepo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BoardRepo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://boardrepo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BoardRepo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BoardRepo provides these MCP tools: get_board, get_bom, list_board_files, list_my_boards, read_file, read_schematic, and search_boards.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BoardRepo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BoardRepo in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
BoardRepo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BoardRepo is developed by Flintt. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
